text:
Ravi (oncall): RCA is up: https://redwood.internal/rca/2954321000 — short summary + actions below. Please read and ack when you own something. :mag:
Maya (prod): TL;DR: fallback routing logic failed to engage for a subset of long-sequence requests during a region-wide transient overload, causing elevated tail latency and 5xx retries for ~27 minutes. No customer data exposure.
Omar (eng-sre): Root cause is a race between the routing cache invalidation and the fallback decision window (race introduced by a recent async cache change). See section 3 for replay logs.
Ravi (oncall): Quick copy for skimmers:
```
Impact window: 2026-06-02 09:14–09:41 UTC
Affected: hosted API long-seq traffic in us-central region (~4% requests)
Symptom: elevated p95/p99 latency and increased client retries
Mitigation: forced fallback routing and increased routing-cache TTL at 09:28 UTC
Customer notice: drafted (ops) — ready for review
```
Helena (support): Customer-facing timeline required — I can own the external note review once ops adds the customer impact lines.
Maya (prod): Action items (owner — due):
- Omar: add a deterministic test that replays cache invalidation + fallback decision race (PR + CI) — due 2026-06-09.
- Ravi: revert the async cache change in a canary and validate routing behavior — due 2026-06-05.
- Claire: review and approve customer credit policy for impacted tenants and sign off on external note — due 2026-06-04 EOD.
- Helena: finalize external post and customer timeline copy — due 2026-06-04 10:00 PT.
- Maya: add a monitoring alert for fallback-path-failure rate and a dashboard panel — due 2026-06-07.
SynthBot: Postmortem checklist updated and action items exported to tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/2954321000
Omar (eng-sre): I'll tag the replay test with the exact sequence that triggered the race and include a small harness for CI.
Ravi (oncall): Mitigations applied: `routing.force_fallback(us-central=true)` and `routing.cache_ttl=300s`. Deploy event: 2026-06-02 09:28 UTC (deploy id dpl-9981).
Maya (prod): Office hours to triage and assign any leftover items: 2026-06-04 16:00 PT (calendar: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/2954321000-rca-review)
Claire (vp-ops): Thank you. Two asks: (1) make sure external message includes clear remediation timeline and any SLA credit steps; (2) Omar/Maya — ensure CI/monitoring changes land before next config rollout.
Helena (support): Ack — I'll coordinate the customer comms review with Claire once draft is ready.
Ravi (oncall): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and accepted action items. I'll check off in the tracker after office hours.
Omar (eng-sre): :white_check_mark:
Maya (prod): :white_check_mark:
Helena (support): :white_check_mark:
Claire (vp-ops): :white_check_mark:
Ravi (oncall): Closing — we'll run a 30m retro after office hours to capture any follow-ups. Ping me if you want to add items.
